programme.title: Dave Grohl On Overcoming Fear And Pursuing Your Dream
programme.desc: Foo Fighters and Nirvana drummer Dave Grohl discusses his new memoir The Storyteller, written during the pandemic. He talks with Fearne Cotton about the law of attraction, pursuing your dreams, and the importance of embracing mistakes and the unknown. Grohl reflects on his journey from hitting the road with Scream at 18 to his time in Nirvana and Foo Fighters, and how storytelling shaped his life from childhood in Springfield, Virginia.

programme.title: Chris McCausland: My Body Rests But My Brain Doesn't!
programme.desc: Comedian Chris McCausland chats with Fearne Cotton about holidays and travel. Chris explains how losing his sight has changed the way he approaches holidays, from planning activities and communicating in foreign countries to managing his dependence on loved ones. He discusses getting into his daughter's favourite holiday hobby: rollercoasters.

programme.title: Ant & Dec On Anxiety, Gratitude & Turning 50
programme.desc: In their first ever podcast appearance, Ant and Dec join Fearne and explain that nearly four decades into their careers they're still laughing together just as much as they did at the beginning, but now they've got far more gratitude for each day they get to be on TV.

programme.title: Caitlin Moran On How She Finally Calmed Her Nervous System
programme.desc: Writer Caitlin Moran discusses her 30-year battle with anxiety that began at age 13, and how she's now two years anxiety-free through choosing to be hopeful and see the good in life. She talks with Fearne Cotton about how social media has altered our perception of reality, the difference between posting angrily online and taking real-world action, social anxiety when meeting friends, and how presuming everyone's having a bad day can make you happier.

programme.title: Ashley Roberts On Coping With Anxiety And Insomnia
programme.desc: Ashley Roberts discusses her journey through burnout and body shaming during the height of the Pussycat Dolls' fame, and how discovering breathwork helped her recover from intense anxiety and physical ill-health. She talks about her mental health toolkit, the grief of losing her dad to suicide, and family mental illness. With Fearne Cotton, she shares experiences of insomnia and coping strategies.

programme.title: Adam Kay Opens Up About The PTSD That Made Him Leave The NHS
programme.desc: Former doctor Adam Kay discusses the traumatic day at work that left him with PTSD and led to his decision to leave the NHS. He explains how the experience affected his mental health, leaving him feeling paranoid and overcautious, and how he turned to diary writing to process his emotions. Adam and Fearne discuss mental health stigma in the workplace and at home, and offer advice for building mental health toolkits for crises of varying severity. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicide.

programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Keir Starmer's Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump's Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: Hugh Jackman Takes On The Irish Test
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman steps up to the ultimate Irish test, trying his hand at making a proper Irish breakfast with mixed results, sharing thoughts on Ryan Reynolds, and tackling classic Irish challenges. Expect plenty of laughs and chaos as Hugh takes on various Irish cultural tasks.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. Do they know what a spicebag is? Can they tell the difference between real and fake Irish sayings? And can they identify some iconic Irish people?

programme.title: Gen Z Watch Little Britain, Fat Families & Jeremy Kyle For The First Time
programme.desc: Gen Z watches Little Britain, Fat Families, and The Jeremy Kyle Show for the first time and gives their honest reactions to some of the most unhinged British television ever made. From outrageous sketches to brutal reality TV moments, they explore whether it was funny, uncomfortable, or both.

programme.title: Chris Pratt Takes On The British Test
programme.desc: Chris Pratt takes on the ultimate British test as he attempts some of the UK's most iconic accents. From London to the North, see how well he really knows British voices and culture.

programme.title: Chris O'Dowd Plays Time Capsule

He discusses Bridesmaids sequel talk and possible MCU ambitions, the Dublin versus London debate, and shares stories and nostalgic moments throughout.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It's a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It's a country that's astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Berlin from Above
programme.desc: Unique pictures from above. This documentary shows a different angle of people and country, during a glide flight above the metropolis. More than 25 years after the reunion between East and West Germany, this movie shows pictures from different perspectives. Which visions and dreams marked this region? What changed and what emerged in Germany's tensed city. We take a look from above to see the city and its citizens. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to see how the people make this area their home. The movie unites nature, urbanity, tranquility and the rush of a metropolis. It unites parks and skyscraper canyons, lake capes and wetlands, curvy courses of rivers and straight streets. With exhilarating pictures we take a trip through Berlin- from sunrise til sunset. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to get a glimpse at how the people make this area their home.

programme.title: Street of Gongs
programme.desc: In Thailand's rural northeast you will find the street of Gongs. Outside the provincial capital of Ubon Ratchatani in Thailand's rural northeast, a country road nearly thirty kilometers long stretches to the banks of the Mekong River. Even from a distance, you can hear what is being made there: gongs of all sizes in nearly 50 manufactories. The gong is considered the ancient instrument and symbol of Asia. It occupies an important cultural significance, initiates rituals, expels demons, gives strength and courage. This film visits the creators of these unique instruments - a family business that has been laboriously handcrafting gongs for generations. They have a big mission: The abbot of the temple has ordered a new, large gong for the upcoming festival. Will they be able to finish it in time?

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some "groove booties" programmed to dance to any beat. She temporarily impresses her friends with her dance moves, but when the groove booties go out of control and threaten the town's Berryball game, she is forced to fess up.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When the girls discover that Apple's groove booties can teach the pups to dance, Plum gets an idea for a Doggie Dance Show. Wanting to impress them, Huck offers to have TomTom join the show... despite the pup's obvious dislike of performing in public. It's up to Strawberry to help Huck see that he should not force TomTom into something he just doesn't want to do.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When a simple tune Cherry composes goes viral on the Berryweb, Cherry quickly gets fed up with everyone listening to this song, everywhere, all the time. She goes to comic lengths to get some peace so she can compose the song she's suppose to write for the Queen of Berryvania.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. Strawberry good-naturedly chuckles at her antics. But Orange gets her dander up and wades into the water to face her "attacker." When she looks down into the water, gazing up at her is the cutest, most adorable, puffy-cheeked fish she's ever seen. It's love at first sight. Orange has to take him home.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! Berry Bitty City is decorated with colorful banners proclaiming the big event. Lemon works the hardest. For weeks she has watered her violets by day and sung to them at night, doing everything she can to win first prize. With the contest just a day away, Lemon is at her garden early.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry Shortcake's friends watch her with wide eyes as she everrrrr-so-gently squirts a layer of blueberry smoothie into a tall glass, trying to not disturb the five other multi-colored layers beneath it. It's her tenth attempt to create the world's first Rainbow Smoothie! She has even painted one wall of her café rainbow colors in honor of the soon-to-be new item on the menu. No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. All the girls are getting their hair done for the gala grand opening of Mr. Longface's new lawn-bowling and croquet club. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry ordered some Zippy Gro daisy seeds and planted them in her garden. She is surprised that they've sprouted in less than a day despite their descriptive moniker. Strawberry comes by to admire them and Blueberry is reminded that the new cookbook Strawberry ordered has arrived. Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. Strawberry follows the muffin recipe, mixes the ingredients, and double checks it.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally wonder why their ball is so bouncy. Then, Nick and Sally are playing on a climbing frame but just can't manage to get to the top.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally want to keep playing, but it's getting dark. Why does nighttime have to come? The Cat knows someone who can answer that question. Then, the kids visit Muddymoo River.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally must protect their cookie jar from cookie snatchers! Then, the kids meet Treetop Tom and see how his tough tongue can pick food off of thorny branches.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are pretending to swim but "why not go for a real swim" asks the Cat! Later, the children go on a trip to visit Princess Lottachoca in the Cocoalicious Forest.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick and Sally are try to guess what animal is the toughest one. Then, the Cat needs to get his fish friend, Ting Tang Tony, back to his family.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick go on a trip to Ozzie-Wozz Outback to help them look after some baby hamsters. Then, Nick and Sally wish they could go as fast as an airplane!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: It's cold outside, but Nick and Sally want to keep playing. Is there a way to stay warm out in the cold? Then, Nick and Sally visit Dr. Giggles.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick try to stump each other by guessing the animal sounds they're making. Then, Sally plays dress up but her favourite hat no longer has any feathers on it! Where can they find more?

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are practising for a three-legged race, but walking on three legs is hard! Then, the kids visit Dr. Twiggles in Fluff'n Stuff Fields.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Nick's hungry tummy is rumbling! But why do our stomachs make noises when they're hungry? Then, Nick and Sally help Cat put his model of the solar system back together!

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: The Cat takes the kids to the Jungle of Bingle-Bungle Boo to meet his friends Emily the Teal, Mikey the Lemur and Greg the Gecko. Then, Nick and Sally pretend to be The Cat in the Hat.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.4
programme.desc: Determined to prove that the sacred jar of King Taejo was deliberately broken, Gangcheon drops the vessel onto the floor. As King Seonjo erupts in fury, Gwanghae steps forward and claims full responsibility for the act. King Seonjo immediately orders Euldam's arrest. In a desperate attempt to save her father, Jeongi strikes the petition drum, proclaiming Euldam's innocence to the court…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.5
programme.desc: Jeongi clings to Euldam, sobbing and begging him not to go, while the wounded Taedo fumes in frustration after seeing an assassin vanish into the darkness. Seeking out Hwa-ryeong, Jeongi travels to the merchant guild, where she comes face to face with Gangcheon. She boldly asks whether he will apologize for humiliating Euldam once she becomes the greatest master potter in Joseon.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.6
programme.desc: Jeongi accuses Gwanghae of stealing her jade belt, and as she tries to flee and leave him behind, she is seized once again by Gwanghae. Forced to wander with their wrists bound together, the two soon find themselves in grave danger. As punishment for losing the royal jade belt, Gwanghae is assigned as deputy director under the chief artisan Shinseong. Meanwhile, Jeongi sets out on a journey to enter the Bunwon pottery workshop…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.7
programme.desc: Reunited at last, Jeongi and Taedo recognize each other and share all that has happened. Taedo reluctantly lets Jeongi go as she sets her sights on the Bunwon workshop. Entering the Gongchogun selection exam, Jeongi is arrested and thrown into jail after being accused of attempting to cut down palace trees while searching for firewood. Desperate, she pleads with Gwanghae for help, insisting that she must become a master potter no matter what.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.8
programme.desc: Mistaking it for Gwanghae's test, Jeongi sneaks into the Bunwon storeroom to choose pottery, only to be caught red-handed by Gangcheon. While confined, she finally realizes that the man she believed to be Gwanghae was actually someone else. As Jeongi tearfully confesses all the wrongs she has committed against him, Gwanghae listens with a quiet smile.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.9
programme.desc: When Jeongi vows to step forward to clear Gwanghae's name, Taedo grows increasingly frustrated. Fearing that his own fate may once again bring injustice upon innocent people, Gwanghae sends Jeongi away. Meanwhile, Hwa-ryeong urges Jeongi to finally let go of Taedo.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a band hoping to touch your heart - Touched! Touched is a quintet composed of guitarist D.on drummer Seung bin Kim vocalist and guitarist YunMin bassist John B.Kim and keyboardist Chae Dohyeon who are all graduates of Seoul Institute of the Arts. They are young as a band but they already have an impressive award-winning career. They won the Grand Prize at the 31st Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest in 2020 as the first band in the contest's history the Grand Prize at the 2021 Pyeongtaek National Band Comepetition the Grand Prize at the Hwaseong City Culture Foundation - RISING STAR 4U and another Grand Prize at the Gyeonggi Content Agency Indiestance. Having won three grand prizes in 2021 alone Touched is considered one of the hottest rookie bands in the Korean music scene. Also combining their intense rock energy with sensitive emotional modern rock the quintet is actively pushing their boundaries creating their own genre. In this episode Touched performs The Dawn Star Hi Bully Call Me Love is Dangerous and their cover of Blue which led them to win the Grand Prize at the Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five talented artists!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is one of Korea's top bands MONNI! Composed of vocalist Kim Shin-eui bassist Lee In-kyoung guitarist Kong Tae-woo and drummer Jung Hun-tae the quartet made their debut in 2005 with the album One Day Light. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they quickly became known in the underground scene and soon impressed the general public through the music shows I'm A Singer Season 3 Immortal Songs: Singing the Legend King of Mask Singer and more. After a break of 7 years they released their fifth full-length album firmament in November this year. Capturing everything up in the sky from the sun to the moon to stars and light it offers a beautiful depiction of the band's identity that they have built for 17 years. In this episode MONNI performs Romantic Breeze Just so-so Tonight LOVESound as well as their new songs You were my star and Again. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out their new releases!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is sogumm famous for her unique voice and heartfelt music! This artist made herself known to the public through one TV competition show in 2019. Thanks to her wide musical spectrum and outstanding producing skills she won the competition and soon joined the record label AOMG. Of course she continued to pleasantly surprised listeners under the label. Her first album Sobrightttttttt earned both critical and commercial success and that success led her to win the coveted Rookie Prize at the 17th Korean Music Awards. She has also collaborated with a numner of A-list artists including ZICO Oh Hyuk 10CM DJ Wegun and Hoody and her ever-evolving artistry definitely makes us anticipate her future as a musician. In October this year sogumm released her full-length album Precious securing her unique spot in the industry. In this episode sogumm performs Insecurity Prescription Precious and more to show off the essence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: 2022 Volvo C40 Recharge

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. programme.title: Ten Things To Do Around The World
LIVEFEED
programme.desc: This video delves into the passionate and tumultuous journey of a small-town romance, capturing the essence of youthful love and heartbreak. The Giant Pig Smokehouse, a beloved local barbecue spot, serves as a backdrop for heartfelt conversations between friends and patrons who share their thoughts on love, loss, and moving forward. Owners Melissa and her brother opened the establishment in 2019, inspired by their love for smoked foods and Southern barbecue traditions. The video showcases their dedication to serving flavorful, family-style meals, emphasizing the importance of patience and love in their cooking. Viewers will hear from various patrons, each with their own story of love and heartache. From a couple reminiscing about their high school days to a person reflecting on a past relationship, the narratives highlight the universal themes of longing, regret, and the hope for new beginnings. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is more than just a restaurant it's a community hub where stories unfold and lives intersect. Whether it's the long lines for their famous pulled pork or the creation of a special menu item due to a customer's misreading, the video paints a vivid picture of a place that nurtures connections and memories. Join us as we explore how love, in all its forms, shapes the experiences of those who walk through its doors.

programme.desc: Loryn, erede di un grande magazzino negli Hamptons, viene messa alla prova dalla nonna nel tentativo di motivarla. Loryn si destreggia tra le attività lavorative nel negozio durante il periodo più intenso dell'anno: il Natale.

programme.title: IO E MR. CHRISTMAS
programme.desc: Zoe Deans, esperta di pubbliche relazioni, lascia la grande agenzia per aprire la propria attività, ma ha bisogno di un cliente importante per farsi notare. Su suggerimento del suo migliore amico Nic, decide di rappresentare un concorrente al concorso natalizio Mr. Christmas, trasformando l'evento in una grande occasione pubblicitaria. Convinta che creare una piccola celebrità natalizia sia facile grazie alla sua esperienza, Zoe si lancia con entusiasmo in questa sfida non convenzionale — decisa a trovare “il ragazzo giusto” da trasformare in star.

programme.title: COME IN UN FILM DI NATALE
programme.desc: Alla vigilia di una scadenza importante, una cinica maniaca del lavoro rimane bloccata in una piccola città del Colorado a causa di un guasto alle luci natalizie. Si ritrova così a recitare il ruolo di protagonista in un film natalizio in stile Hallmark.

programme.title: UN TOCCO DI CREATIVITÀ A NATALE
programme.desc: Harper, un'aspirante illustratrice, sta collaborando con Caleb, un autore di libri molto esigente. Quando lui insiste affinché lei lavori durante il periodo natalizio in una pittoresca cittadina, lei deve sfruttare i festeggiamenti natalizi della città per aiutarlo a superare il suo blocco dello scrittore.

programme.title: Un Orso Di Nome Winnie
programme.desc: Le origini di Winnie the Pooh. La storia vera di Harry Colebourn, un soldato canadese che, ai tempi della Primo conflitto mondiale, comprò un cucciolo di orso rimasto orfano, lo addomesticò e gli diede il nome della sua città natale: Winnipeg.

programme.title: La sera di tutti i giorni
programme.desc: La sera di tutti i giorni, il film diretto da Felix Tissi, racconta storie slegate ma unite dal tema della vecchiaia, attraverso i temi dell'amore e della morte.

programme.title: Racconti Romani
programme.desc: Uscito dal carcere di Regina Coeli, Alvaro riprende il suo ruolo di "leader" del quartiere. Una Roma di fine anni '50 nel classico con Totò, la splendida Silvana Pampanini e il grande Vittorio De Sica.

programme.title: True women
programme.desc: Nel west dei mitici anni della frontiera Georgia Lawshe Woods si oppone alle strette regole morali per affermare sé stessa. Si appassiona alla politica affronta i pericoli della guerra e combatte l'ostilità degli indiani.

programme.title: Totòtruffa 62
programme.desc: Antonio e Felice sono due simpatiche canaglie che, grazie alla capacità di travestirsi, tirano avanti con furti e piccoli raggiri. Il tutto per mantenere Diana, figlia di Antonio, in un lussuoso collegio.

programme.title: La Rosa Velenosa
programme.desc: Carson Phillips, investigatore privato, viene coinvolto dalla sua ex-moglie in una indagine relativa all'uccisione del fidanzato della figlia. L'indagine prenderà una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Third Person
programme.desc: Tre storie di passione, fiducia e tradimento, che prendono vita in tre città diverse, dove si dipanano le vicende di tre coppie che sembrano non avere nulla in comune, se non un invisibile, flebile legame.

programme.title: Jimmy Bobo
programme.desc: Un action movie adrenalinico con protagonisti Sylvester Stallone, Jason Momoa e Christian Slater in cui, dopo aver assistito alla morte dei rispettivi partner, un assassino di New Orleans e un detective di Washington si alleano per abbattere il nemico comune.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Bloccate a 47 metri di profondità, due sorelle lottano per sopravvivere mentre l'ossigeno si esaurisce e squali bianchi le circondano. La risalita è l'unica speranza, ma ogni movimento potrebbe attirare i predatori. La paura può uccidere prima ancora degli squali.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Un'immersione tra le rovine di una città sommersa si trasforma in un incubo. Quattro amiche sono intrappolate sott'acqua, circondate da squali letali e cunicoli che sembrano stringersi attorno a loro. Sopravvivere richiede sangue freddo… e pura fortuna.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente aereo, cinque amici si ritrovano su una zattera in mezzo al mare, senza cibo né aiuto in vista. Gli squali affamati pattugliano ogni loro mossa, trasformando il mare in una trappola mortale. Sopravvivere sembra impossibile, ma arrendersi non è un'opzione.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: Una ragazza cieca riceve un trapianto di cornea per tornare a vedere. Tuttavia, si accorge presto di poter vedere tutto... anche fantasmi inquietanti.

programme.title: Pazzie d'amore
programme.desc: Christa Bright è un'aspirante personal stylist che entra subito in sintonia con la sua nuova cliente Kat Niven, una donna timida che ha bisogno di aiuto per acquisire sicurezza. Ma l'ammirazione di Kat si trasforma presto in una vera e propria ossessione per Christa ed il suo fidanzato, e non si fermerà davanti a nulla per ottenere ciò che vuole.

programme.title: La playlist del cuore
programme.desc: La storia segue Amanda, che si offre volontaria per organizzare la festa di lancio dell'azienda. Le viene affiancato Sam, che sembra arrogante, ma lei non sa che è lo stesso uomo con cui sta flirtando in una chat anonima.

programme.title: La voce del cuore
programme.desc: La coach relazionale Sam crede di poter aggiustare qualsiasi storia d'amore e sta creando un podcast per dimostrarlo. Ma il vivace produttore Josh la sfida a mettere alla prova il suo stesso cuore.

programme.title: L'anello perfetto
programme.desc: La vita di Kate Sterling è tutta dedicata alle proposte di matrimonio. Come designer di gioielli ha creato anelli per più coppie felici di quante ne possa contare, ma non ne ha ancora creati per sé. In occasione del matrimonio di sua sorella, Kate ha la possibilità di riallacciare i rapporti con il suo amore d'infanzia. Ora deve decidere se i loro sentimenti sono cambiati o se il matrimonio riaccenderà la scintilla che un tempo li univa, dando a Kate l'anello che aspettava da una vita.

programme.title: La radio del cuore
programme.desc: Samantha Desouza, conduttrice di un podcast di successo, ha una passione per la musica, ma un'avversione le storie d'amore a causa di una recente esperienza negativa. Proprio quando il suo programma sta decollando, il suo capo la getta nel baratro assegnandole il compito di condurre Heartwaves, un programma di canzoni d'amore con una parte dedicata a riunire vecchi amori perduti. Nonostante la sua iniziale mancanza di entusiasmo, Samantha è determinata a risolvere il problema del suo primo interlocutore: il carismatico e affascinante Jake. Quello che non si sarebbe mai aspettata è che, nel frattempo, i due si innamorassero l'uno dell'altra. Ora Sam deve decidere se evitare di innamorarsi di nuovo o essere un po' più spontanea e seguire il proprio cuore.

programme.title: Dangerous Beauty
programme.desc: Alla fine del 1500, come amanti degli uomini importanti di Venezia, le donne avevano uno stile di vita regale ed erano incoraggiate a leggere e a studiare in un periodo in cui l'istruzione era proibita per la maggior parte delle donne.

programme.title: Sesso, bugie... e difetti di fabbrica
programme.desc: Angela è un'ambiziosa donna d'affari che lavora per un boss molto esigente, e che deve vedersela col marito Curtis e, soprattutto, con un'inaspettata gravidanza che le creerà non pochi problemi sul lavoro e nella vita privata.

programme.title: Conversazioni con altre donne
programme.desc: Nove anni dopo essersi lasciati, due ex anime gemelle si incontrano casualmente durante un ricevimento di nozze a Tropea.

programme.title: My Old Lady
programme.desc: Mathias Gold, un giramondo newyorkese, si reca a Parigi per liquidare un lussuoso appartamento ereditato dal padre. Una volta a Parigi, Mathias scopre che nel suo appartamento risiede un'anziana signora di nome Mathilde insieme alla figlia Chloé.

programme.title: The Clue to Love
programme.desc: L'ambiziosa Audrey Harper si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere sulla speciale ma anonima rubrica di consigli amorosi Chiedi a zia Hope, un pilastro del giornale locale della città. Incontra così l'affascinante caporedattore Morgan Cooper, che la aiuta a scoprire la vera identità della "zia Hope".

programme.title: Un padre in prestito
programme.desc: Per poter adottare un ragazzo problematico, un impiegato postale solitario e non sposato deve dimostrare di essere emotivamente qualificato per amare e accudire un bambino.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone è il numero uno dei controllori del traffico aereo, finché un tranquillo sconosciuto, Russell Bell, non viene trasferito nel dipartimento. La rivalità tra i due migliori controllori del traffico aereo del TRACON di New York sale a un livello potenzialmente pericoloso.

programme.title: The idol
programme.desc: Siamo a Gaza. Sinonimo di tanti conflitti, distruzione e disperazione, ma per Mohammed Assaf e sua sorella Nour, Gaza è la loro casa e il loro parco giochi. E' dove, insieme ai loro migliori amici Ahmad e Omar, fanno musica, giocano a calcio e hanno il coraggio di sognare in grande.

programme.title: Tra cielo e terra
programme.desc: La vera storia delle peripezie di una donna Vietnamita, dall'infanzia disperata nel paese devastato dal conflitto alla vita di sposa di guerra americana - e non solo.

programme.title: The Californians
programme.desc: In una versione di 'Le bostoniane' di Henry James, una battaglia infuria tra due fratelli. Gavin, uno scaltro imprenditore, e sua sorella Olive, un'ambientalista risoluta. Ma una straordinaria cantante, Zoe, si interpone tra i due.

programme.title: Un amore di pasticceri
programme.desc: Jessie è una panettiera che ama il suo negozio più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando gli sviluppatori minacciano di costringerla ad andarsene, deve salvare la sua panetteria, mentre si destreggia con una storia d'amore in piena fioritura.

programme.title: Addestramento DAmore
programme.desc: Quando una scrittice di romanzi incontra un uomo della Marina, per una ricerca per il suo prossimo libro, viene colpita dalla sua forte personalità. Sceglierà di sposare l'uomo che pensava di amare o la versione reale del suo personaggio fittizio?

programme.title: Un Matrimonio Da Salvare
programme.desc: Billie è l'affascinante proprietaria di una società di donazioni di matrimoni. I suoi clienti, Max e Jess, annullano il matrimonio. Billie e Charlie, i fratelli di Max, dovranno lavorare insieme per far sposare questa coppia.

programme.title: Due cuori e una baita
programme.desc: La stacanovista Jillian vuole vendere una baita di montagna, ma il bel custode Liam le fa un'offerta. Volano scintille quando trasformano la baita in un resort. Ma quando gli affari non vanno secondo i piani, Jillian rinuncerà a tutto per amore?

programme.title: Ricomincio Da Te
programme.desc: La trentenne Daphe ha appena chiuso una relazione. A una festa incontra due uomini affascinanti e opposti: con entrambi avvia una relazione.

programme.title: Fuggiamo insieme
programme.desc: Quando una ragazza appena sposata scopre che suo marito è un nazista, lo lascia e scappa con un giornalista radiofonico che si innamora di lei mentre la segue alla ricerca di una storia su suo marito.

programme.title: La Regina degli scacchi
programme.desc: Maria Adele, 17 anni, vive per gli scacchi, ma scopre di essere stata adottata e, con l'aiuto di un giornalista, rintraccia la madre biologica. Mentre riaffiora un ricordo d'infanzia che la libera dai tormenti, emerge un'indagine che svela crimini del suo maestro di scacchi, culminati in un tragico epilogo.

programme.title: Dalle 5 Alle 7
programme.desc: Un aspirante romanziere comincia una relazione con una donna, anche se c'è solo un problema: la donna è sposata e la coppia può incontrarsi solo tra le 5 e le 7 ogni sera.

programme.title: Mrs. Mills
programme.desc: Helene possiede un appartamento chic nel centro di Parigi, pubblica romanzi romanticamente kitsch e conduce una vita completamente dettata dal lavoro. Tutto il suo amore è per i libri. Ma la sua vita quotidiana viene stravolta quando la signora Mills, un'eccentrica signora americana, si trasferisce nell'appartamento accanto.

programme.title: La Comune
programme.desc: Erik e Anna, con la figlia Freja, creano una comune nella villa di famiglia a Copenhagen. Tra amicizie, feste e sogni condivisi, l'equilibrio viene spezzato da una relazione inaspettata che metterà alla prova il legame tra i membri della comunità.

programme.title: Tutta colpa del vulcano
programme.desc: Per i viaggiatori di tutto il mondo l'eruzione del vulcano Eyjafjallajökull è un duro colpo. Per Alain e Valerie è un disastro. Per poter arrivare nel piccolo villaggio della Grecia per il matrimonio della loro figlia, questa coppia di divorziati, che nutre un odio reciproco senza limiti, sarà costretta a intraprendere il viaggio insieme.

programme.title: Un divano a tunisi
programme.desc: Selma, giovane psicanalista, torna a Tunisi all'indomani della Primavera araba, decisa ad aprire uno studio privato si scontrerà con un ambiente sfavorevole.

programme.title: Parlami Di Te
programme.desc: Alain è un uomo d'affari che non concede alcuno spazio alle distrazioni e alla famiglia. Viene colpito da un ictus, che gli lascia una grave difficoltà nell'espressione verbale e una perdita della memoria. Si affida a una giovane logopedista.

programme.title: Biancaneve al college
programme.desc: In una commedia universitaria che rivisita in chiave moderna una storia antica, “Sydney White” racconta di una matricola maschiaccio che lascia le sue infide consorelle e trova una nuova casa con un gruppo di emarginati molto sfigati. Stufa del modo in cui sono stati trattati, dichiara guerra contro l'élite del campus.

programme.title: Biancaneve al college
programme.desc: In una commedia universitaria che rivisita in chiave moderna una storia antica, “Sydney White” racconta di una matricola maschiaccio che lascia le sue infide consorelle e trova una nuova casa con un gruppo di emarginati molto sfigati. Stufa del modo in cui sono stati trattati, dichiara guerra contro l'élite del campus.

programme.title: Sballati Per Le Feste!
programme.desc: Ethan, Isaac e Chris sono amici fin dall'infanzia e per un decennio si sono incontrati una volta all'anno per una reunion la vigilia di Natale, una serata all'insegna della dissolutezza e dell'ilarità. Ora che stanno entrando nell'età adulta, la tradizione sta volgendo al termine e per renderla il più possibile memorabile, si prefiggono di trovare il 'Nutcracka Ball', il Santo Graal delle feste natalizie.

programme.title: Tutte Pazze Per Charlie
programme.desc: A una festa, Chuck, dieci anni, non rispetta la regola del gioco della bottiglia, rifiutandosi di baciare una ragazza. Determinata a non far trovare a Chuck il vero amore, questa, per vendetta, gli getta il malocchio. Vent'anni dopo Chuck è un dentista che non riesce ad avere una relazione stabile.

programme.title: La pretora
programme.desc: Una pretora inflessibili affronta i ricatti dei rivali che usano la gemella pornostar, ma lei reagisce con fermezza

programme.title: La gatta da pelare
programme.desc: Mara e Stefano hanno alcuni problemi: lei va dallo psicoanalista Maraldi, lui lo minaccia e lo "uccide" nei fumetti

programme.title: Un amore in prima classe
programme.desc: Un padre viaggia in treno con il figlio , cercando anche di corteggiare una scienziata.

programme.title: Travolto dagli affetti familiari
programme.desc: Un uomo cerca di bilanciare un matrimonio d'interesse con l'affetto per nonna e cane

programme.title: Accadde al penitenziario
programme.desc: In un penitenziario, le disavventure di un gruppo di detenuti e delle loro relazioni con il personale, tra situazioni comiche e paradossali, creando un mix di risate e riflessioni sulla vita dietro le sbarre.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: Il medico dei pazzi
programme.desc: Dalla commedia di Eduardo Scarpetta. Totò è il generoso zio di uno scapestrato nipote, che l'ha ingannato dicendo di essersi laureato e di dirigere una clinica psichiatrica (in realtà la clinica non esiste, è solo un mezzo per spillar quattrini). Totò un giorno arriva a Napoli per controllare la vita del nipotastro. Capita nella pensione di questi e prende i pensionanti per matti.

programme.title: Il marito
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.

programme.title: I tartassati
programme.desc: Totò e Aldo Fabrizi, alle prese con le difficoltà quotidiane, affrontano la burocrazia e le complicazioni fiscali con una serie di disavventure comiche e situazioni paradossali, esplorando con ironia le difficoltà della vita moderna.

programme.title: Viva la Muerte…tua!
programme.desc: Franco Nero ed Eli Wallach in un cult dello spaghetti western tra truffe, sparatorie e caccia al tesoro sullo sfondo della rivoluzione messicana.

programme.title: Boys
programme.desc: Joe, Carlo, Bobo e Giacomo sono i "Boys", una rock band che ha avuto un enorme (quanto fulmineo) successo negli anni Settanta. Oggi, nonostante abbiano preso strade diverse, il loro è ancora un legame di amicizia fraterna.

programme.title: Ladre per Caso
programme.desc: Carole è un'informatica introversa che vive ancora da sua madre. Caroline è una borseggiatrice ribelle che saccheggia i grandi hotel della Costa Azzurra. Le due giovani donne non si conoscono e non hanno niente in comune. Niente scomparso prima della loro nascita e che non hanno mai visto.

programme.title: Little Monsters
programme.desc: Lupita Nyong'o, Josh Gad e Alexander England sono protagonisti di questa commedia horror dedicata a tutte le insegnanti di scuola materna che motivano i bambini ad imparare, infondendo fiducia e proteggendoli dal diventare prede degli zombi.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Crimen Perfecto
programme.desc: Rafael ama vestirsi bene e si accompagna solo con belle donne. Di sposarsi non ne vuol sapere e si gode il successo come venditore in un grande magazzino. Quando uccide involontariamente un collega, subisce il ricattato di una misteriosa commessa.

programme.title: Love shooting
programme.desc: Charlie è un produttore cinematografico che si lascia convincere a realizzare un film su Benjamin Disraeli, a patto che il protagonista sia un attore di grande fama che però verrà rapito, costringendo Charlie ad escogitare una soluzione creativa.

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: Se Permetti Non Parlarmi Di Bambini
programme.desc: Da quando si è separato, Gabriel non ha fatto altro che pensare a sua figlia Sofia. Un giorno si presenta al suo negozio di musica Vicky, una donna del suo passato, oggi più affascinante che mai, a cui però non piacciono i bambini.

programme.title: L'ira di Achille
programme.desc: Sullo sfondo della guerra di Troia, Achille affronta battaglie e passioni travolgenti guidato dall'onore e dalla sete di vendetta.

programme.title: El Zorro
programme.desc: ra intrighi e ingiustizie, il misterioso Zorro combatte contro l'oppressione difendendo il popolo con astuzia e abilità, tra duelli e azioni spettacolari.

programme.title: Zorro contro Maciste
programme.desc: Tra duelli e imprese eroiche, Zorro e Maciste uniscono le forze contro un potere tirannico, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi

programme.title: Maciste nella Terra dei Ciclopi
programme.desc: Tra mostri, terre misteriose e battaglie leggendarie, Maciste affronta i ciclopi per salvare un popolo minacciato

programme.title: Maciste contro i cacciatori di teste
programme.desc: Maciste guida il suo popolo lontano da un'isola devastata dalle eruzioni vulcaniche. Il viaggio li conduce in una terra dominata da tribù in guerra, dove l'eroe dovrà affrontare guerrieri e cacciatori di teste per salvare i superstiti.

programme.title: I vigliacchi non pregano
programme.desc: Un gruppo di vigilantes del nord, che vagano nel sud del dopoguerra, attacca e uccide la fidanzata del veterano di guerra Brian, che viene salvato dal suo amico Daniel. I due, con il fratello Robert, si mettono alla ricerca degli assassini ma Brian soffre di amnesia.

programme.title: Per 100.000 dollari t'ammazzo
programme.desc: Johnny Forest, cacciatore di taglie, vuole esaudire l'ultimo desiderio della madre: catturare vivo suo fratello fuorilegge, Clint. Mentre cercano di sfuggire a Jurago, un ex socio ostile, Clint accetta temporaneamente l'aiuto di Johnny e decide di arrendersi, almeno per il momento.

programme.title: Buon funerale amigos!... paga Sartana
programme.desc: Dopo un brutale massacro, Sartana arriva a Indian Creek deciso a scoprire la verità. Quasi tutti sembrano voler mettere le mani sulle proprietà delle vittime, e chiunque potrebbe essere l'assassino. Con uno sceriffo poco affidabile e troppi sospetti, Sartana deve trovare da solo il colpevole nascosto tra loro.

programme.title: Uno di più all'inferno
programme.desc: Johnny King, vagabondo ribelle, cerca vendetta per l'omicidio del suo mentore Steve, eliminato dai fratelli Ward per rubargli la terra. Dopo aver messo i Ward in difficoltà, Johnny si trova però davanti a un nuovo nemico inatteso: Meredith, un vecchio amico diventato fuorilegge.

programme.title: Lo credevano uno stinco di santo
programme.desc: Un gruppo di fuorilegge sono in cerca del tesoro nascosto di un vecchio prigioniero: solo uno lo troverà

programme.title: I quattro inesorabili
programme.desc: Quattro cacciatori di taglie del Texas cercano vendetta contro un ranger che ha scagionato il loro ricercato.

programme.title: Sette ore di fuoco
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill guida una carovana di pionieri e affronta una banda di contrabbandieri che vende armi ai Sioux.

programme.title: Tutto per tutto
programme.desc: A El Paso, l'indiano Faccia di Rame cerca vendetta contro il ladro Carranza per l'oro rubato.

programme.title: L'ombra di Zorro
programme.desc: I fratelli Billy e Dan vanno in California per uccidere Zorro e vendicare la morte del loro fratello.

programme.title: Rock Legends
programme.desc: Scopri la vita e l'impatto culturale di queste leggendarie icone musicali, tra interviste e performance.

programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.title: Brigitte Bardot: the icon of France
programme.desc: Il racconto dell'ascesa al successo del mito di Brigitte Bardot, incarnazione della sensualità femminile.

programme.title: I Maestri Del Cinema: Billy Wilder
programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi registi del XX secolo. Gli esordi, le difficoltà e infine i film e il cinema.

programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: L'Ultimo Giorno Da Rockstar: Elvis Presley
programme.desc: Il documentario ripercorre la storia del re del pop, Elvis Presley, fino alla sua improvvisa morte nel 1977.

programme.desc: Scopri la vita e l'impatto culturale di queste leggendarie icone musicali, tra interviste e performance.
